messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

reasoning:
The user wants an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle. This is a whimsical drawing request. Let me create a clear, recognizable SVG combining a pelican (big beak with pouch, round body) on a bicycle (two wheels, frame, handlebars, pedals).

Let me design coordinates. Canvas 400x300.

Bicycle: two wheels centered around (110, 220) and (290, 220), radius 40. Frame connecting them, seat post, handlebars.

Pelican sits on the seat: body oval around (190, 150), big beak pointing forward-right with pouch, wing, eye, legs pedaling.

Let me lay out concretely:

Rear wheel: cx=110 cy=225 r=45. Front wheel: cx=295 cy=225 r=45.
Frame: rear hub (110,225) to seat tube bottom around (170,225) to seat post top (175,150). Down tube from (170,225) to... simpler: draw frame lines:
- Chain stay: (110,225) to (185,225) (bottom bracket)
- Seat stay: (110,225) to (172,155)
- Seat tube: (185,225) to (172,155)
- Down tube: (185,225) to (280,170)
- Head tube/fork: (280,170) to (295,225)
- Top tube: (172,155) to (280,170)
- Handlebar: from (280,170) up to (285,145), with bar horizontal.

Pedals at bottom bracket (185,225) with a crank.

Pelican: body ellipse centered (180,135) rx 45 ry 35. Neck/head: head circle at (230,95) r ~22. Beak long pointing right: upper bill from (248,95) to (320,105), pouch curve below. Eye at (235,90). Wing on body. Legs from body down to pedals at (185,225).

Make pelican body gray/white, beak orange, wheels dark.

Add ground line optional. Motion lines for flair.

Write SVG with groups. Keep it clean.
answer:
```svg
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" width="400" height="300">
  <!-- Sky background -->
  <rect width="400" height="300" fill="#cfe8f5"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="50" r="22" fill="#ffd75e"/>
  <ellipse cx="320" cy="45" rx="30" ry="12" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="345" cy="52" rx="22" ry="9" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.9"/>

  <!-- Ground -->
  <rect x="0" y="270" width="400" height="30" fill="#8fbf6b"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="270" x2="400" y2="270" stroke="#5e8a42" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Speed lines -->
  <g stroke="#7fb0d0" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="30" y1="120" x2="60" y2="120"/>
    <line x1="20" y1="145" x2="55" y2="145"/>
    <line x1="35" y1="170" x2="70" y2="170"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Bicycle -->
  <g stroke="#333" stroke-width="5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
    <!-- Wheels -->
    <circle cx="110" cy="225" r="45" stroke="#222"/>
    <circle cx="110" cy="225" r="38" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="295" cy="225" r="45" stroke="#222"/>
    <circle cx="295" cy="225" r="38" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Spokes -->
    <g stroke="#aaa" stroke-width="1.5">
      <line x1="110" y1="187" x2="110" y2="263"/>
      <line x1="72" y1="225" x2="148" y2="225"/>
      <line x1="83" y1="198" x2="137" y2="252"/>
      <line x1="137" y1="198" x2="83" y2="252"/>
      <line x1="295" y1="187" x2="295" y2="263"/>
      <line x1="257" y1="225" x2="333" y2="225"/>
      <line x1="268" y1="198" x2="322" y2="252"/>
      <line x1="322" y1="198" x2="268" y2="252"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Frame -->
    <line x1="110" y1="225" x2="185" y2="225"/>   <!-- chain stay -->
    <line x1="110" y1="225" x2="172" y2="155"/>   <!-- seat stay -->
    <line x1="185" y1="225" x2="172" y2="155"/>   <!-- seat tube -->
    <line x1="185" y1="225" x2="280" y2="170"/>   <!-- down tube -->
    <line x1="172" y1="155" x2="280" y2="170"/>   <!-- top tube -->
    <line x1="280" y1="170" x2="295" y2="225"/>   <!-- fork -->
    <line x1="280" y1="170" x2="287" y2="140"/>   <!-- head tube -->
    <!-- Handlebar -->
    <path d="M287,140 q12,-8 22,-2 q6,4 2,12"/>
    <!-- Seat -->
    <path d="M155,152 q17,-12 34,-2 q-16,8 -34,2 z" fill="#6b4a2b" stroke="#4a3320"/>
    <!-- Crank and pedals -->
    <circle cx="185" cy="225" r="7" fill="#555"/>
    <line x1="185" y1="225" x2="172" y2="207" stroke-width="4"/>
    <line x1="185" y1="225" x2="198" y2="243" stroke-width="4"/>
    <rect x="163" y="203" width="16" height="7" fill="#444" stroke="none" rx="2"/>
    <rect x="191" y="241" width="16" height="7" fill="#444" stroke="none" rx="2"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Pelican -->
  <g>
    <!-- Legs -->
    <g stroke="#e8842a" stroke-width="6" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round">
      <path d="M175,165 L168,205"/>
      <path d="M190,168 L196,240"/>
    </g>
    <!-- Feet on pedals -->
    <path d="M160,205 h18 l-6,8 h-14 z" fill="#e8842a"/>
    <path d="M188,240 h18 l-6,8 h-14 z" fill="#e8842a"/>

    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="178" cy="138" rx="48" ry="36" fill="#f2f2ef" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- Tail -->
    <path d="M132,125 l-20,-12 4,14 -14,-4 18,14 z" fill="#e6e6e2" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2.5"/>
    <!-- Wing -->
    <path d="M150,125 q35,-18 62,8 q-28,22 -62,-8 z" fill="#dcdcd7" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
    <path d="M158,130 q20,-6 38,6" stroke="#999" stroke-width="2" fill="none"/>

    <!-- Neck -->
    <path d="M205,115 q10,-40 28,-45 q10,26 -4,52" fill="#f2f2ef" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>

    <!-- Head -->
    <circle cx="235" cy="88" r="21" fill="#f2f2ef" stroke="#555" stroke-width="3"/>
    <!-- Upper beak -->
    <path d="M252,82 L322,98 q4,3 -2,5 L252,94 z" fill="#f0912e" stroke="#8a4a10" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- Pouch -->
    <path d="M252,94 Q288,124 318,101 L252,94 z" fill="#f7b05c" stroke="#8a4a10" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <!-- Eye -->
    <circle cx="240" cy="82" r="4.5" fill="#222"/>
    <circle cx="241.5" cy="80.5" r="1.5" fill="#fff"/>
    <!-- Head tuft -->
    <path d="M228,70 q4,-8 10,-3" stroke="#555" stroke-width="2.5" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  </g>
</svg>
```

This SVG shows a gray-and-white pelican with a big orange pouch beak, pedaling a bicycle across a meadow with a sun, cloud, and speed lines for motion. You can copy it into a `.svg` file or embed it directly in HTML. Want me to tweak colors, add a helmet, or make it look more cartoonish or realistic?
